title: Breadcrumb expansion
description: Hidden ancestors unfold inline, keeping the current document anchored in a readable path.
useCase: Reveal and navigate a compact project hierarchy without a detached parent menu.
interaction: Expand the ellipsis, choose an ancestor, and open its child to return. Escape collapses the trail.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Four local hierarchy levels with one child each; no filesystem or router integration. The original SVG cover is illustrative content.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a white rounded card: a breadcrumb bar with folder icon, slash separators and ellipsis chip, above a tilted orange cover thumbnail.
motion: Clicking the ellipsis widens the hidden-ancestors slot to its measured width over 280 ms ease-out as folder names fade and slide in; navigating swaps the content with a short slide-fade.
adapt: Expansion is the `parent-wrap` width transition to `parentWidth` (measured from `scrollWidth` in `useLayoutEffect`) plus the `parents` fade and offset; content swaps replay `sf-path-content`. Replace `PATH` and the file detail with your hierarchy; keep the focus return in `collapse`.
